results.title: VQualA 2025 Challenge on Engagement Prediction for Short Videos: Methods and Results
results.snippet: This paper presents an overview of the VQualA 2025 Challenge on Engagement Prediction for Short Videos, held in conjunction with ICCV 2025. The challenge focuses on understanding and modeling the popularity of user-generated content (UGC) short videos on social media platforms. To support this goal, the challenge uses a new short-form UGC dataset featuring engagement metrics derived from real-world user interactions. This objective of the Challenge is to promote robust modeling strategies that capture the complex factors influencing user engagement. Participants explored a variety of multi-mo…

results.title: The 2025 Foundation Model Transparency Index
results.snippet: Foundation model developers are among the world's most important companies. As these companies become increasingly consequential, how do their transparency practices evolve? The 2025 Foundation Model Transparency Index is the third edition of an annual effort to characterize and quantify the transparency of foundation model developers. The 2025 FMTI introduces new indicators related to data acquisition, usage data, and monitoring and evaluates companies like Alibaba, DeepSeek, and xAI for the first time. The 2024 FMTI reported that transparency was improving, but the 2025 FMTI finds this prog…

results.title: Inference-Time Attention Steering for Vision-Language-Action Driving Models
results.snippet: Vision-language-action (VLA) driving models couple a reasoning stage with a diffusion-based trajectory decoder, but do not give a direct way to redirect attention toward safety-critical actors at inference time without retraining. We studied a bounded additive pre-softmax attention bias on the visual tokens of detector localized traffic actors on Alpamayo-R1's Qwen3-VL backbone. It is applied as a fail open forward pre-hook with no weight changes. On 50 lane-change scenarios from the Physical AI World Model Synthetic dataset. The trajectory decoder shows a monotonic dose response in the bias…

results.title: Compositional Context Fine-Tuning Vision-Language Model for Complex Assembly Action Understanding from Videos
results.snippet: Assembly action understanding is a key enabler for effective human-robot collaborative assembly, yet it remains challenging due to subtle motions and fine-grained hand-object interactions. We adapt vision-language models (VLMs) to this challenging domain with Compositional Context Fine-Tuning (CCFT), a method that decomposes assembly actions into semantic elements (Verb, Object, Tool) and fine-tunes VLMs to recognize each action element using templated question-answering pairs. This approach ensures near-deterministic outputs. To enable efficient and effective multi-task learning under limite…

findings.point: 2026 年 8 月提出针对 VLA 驾驶模型的推理时注意力引导方法，无需重训练即可将视觉注意力重定向至安全关键交通参与者
findings.evidence: 在 Alpamayo-R1 的 Qwen3-VL 主干上，对检测器定位的交通参与者视觉 token 施加有界加性 pre-softmax 注意力偏置，实现推理阶段的安全导向注意力调制
findings.attention: 中：新方法针对 VLA 驾驶安全痛点，但为预印本尚无独立复现/基准验证
findings.recommendation: ★★★☆☆：解决 VLA 推理时可控性的新思路，值得关注后续真车验证与开源情况

findings.point: 2026 年 7 月提出组合上下文微调 (CCFT) 方法，将装配动作分解为语义要素 (Verb, Object, Tool) 以适配 VLM 进行复杂装配动作理解
findings.evidence: 针对人机协作装配中细微动作与精细手-物交互难题，通过分解动作语义要素微调 VLM，提升复杂装配视频的动作理解能力
findings.attention: 中：面向灵巧操作/装配场景的 VLM 适配新范式，但为预印本且未见公开基准对比
findings.recommendation: ★★★☆☆：为具身装配任务提供可解释的 VLM 微调路径，关注后续真机部署与数据集释放

results.title: LIBERO-Para: A Diagnostic Benchmark and Metrics for Paraphrase Robustness in VLA Models
results.snippet: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models achieve strong performance in robotic manipulation by leveraging pre-trained vision-language backbones. To study this gap, we introduce LIBERO-Para, a controlled benchmark that independently varies action expressions and object references for fine-grained analysis of linguistic generalization. results.title: LIBERO-PeRM: Benchmarking Personalized Robotic Manipulation
results.snippet: Personalization is essential for general-purpose robots to transition into household environments and achieve true practicality. While general robotic manipulation has been extensively studied, personalized robotic manipulation (PeRM) lacks a controlled benchmark for separating task completion from preference satisfaction. We introduce LIBERO-PeRM, a benchmark for preference learning in embodied agents. LIBERO-PeRM studies five questions: 1) how policies follow preferences in zero-shot settings; 2) how they learn single preferences from demonstrations; 3) how efficiently they acquire preferen…

results.title: LIBERO-Industry: Benchmarking Robotic Manipulation under Industrial Process Constraints
results.snippet: Industrial manipulation in flexible manufacturing, e.g., high-mix, low-volume (HMLV) electronics assembly, requires robot policies to adapt to changing products and production conditions. Such settings impose industrial process constraints, including product variants, moving material flows, finite execution windows, and tight geometric tolerances. However, existing evaluation frameworks do not systematically capture these constraints when assessing generalist robot policies. To address this gap, we introduce LIBERO-Industry, a novel benchmark built on the widely used robot learning benchmark…

findings.point: LIBERO 基准家族在 2026 年扩展了三个新维度：指令改写鲁棒性、个性化偏好满足、工业流程约束
findings.evidence: LIBERO-Para 专注于 VLA 模型对指令改写的鲁棒性，发现 22-52 个百分点的性能下降，主要源于对象级词汇变化；LIBERO-PeRM 引入个性化机器人操作基准，分离任务完成与偏好满足；LIBERO-Industry 面向高混低量电子装配，建模产品变体、物料流动、执行窗口与几何公差等工业约束
findings.attention: 中 | 三个新基准同期发布，填补了 VLA 评测在语言泛化、个性化、工业落地三个维度的空白
findings.recommendation: ★★★★☆ | 系统性扩展 LIBERO 评测体系，直接对应 VLA 从实验室走向家庭与工厂的关键缺口

# 具身智能与视觉-语言-动作（VLA）前沿调研报告：2024-2026 七维增量快照

**日期**：2026-11-08（UTC）  
**领域**：Embodied AI / Vision-Language-Action (VLA) / Robotics  
**检索源数量**：30 条可引用来源（编号 [1]-[30]），其中高度相关 VLA 来源 10 条（[6]-[10], [12], [20]-[23], [24]）  
**方法论**：遵循 `deep-research`、`frontier-tracking`、`paper-survey`、`evidence-grading`、`frontier-watch` 五大 Skill 要求，严格执行“四阶段流程”与“七维增量骨架”，所有论断强制带 `[n]` 引用，无证处标注 `> 待核实`。

---

## 1. 进展与热点（Progress & Hotspots）

### 1.1 一句话增量判断
**相对 2023 年底基线，2024-2026 年 VLA 领域的核心增量在于：推理时可控机制（注意力引导、工具使用）、面向复杂装配/灵巧操作的语义分解微调范式、以及 LIBERO 基准体系向“语言鲁棒性、个性化偏好、工业约束、视觉闭环鲁棒性”四个实战维度的系统性扩展；但 2024-2025 年核心主干模型（RT-2、OpenVLA、π0、GR-1 等）与 Open X-Embodiment/DROID/SimplerEnv 主流榜单的最新 SOTA 分数在本证据集中**完全缺失**，属重大**不确定**区。**

## 3. 蓝海与缺口（Blue Ocean & Gaps）

### 3.1 一句话增量判断
**结合 1.5 与 2.3，当前 VLA 领域最大的蓝海在于：面向“长尾安全、跨本体泛化、工业级约束满足、个性化偏好对齐、推理时可控/可解释”的**系统性工程化解决方案**；而非单点模型 SOTA 刷榜。LIBERO-Para/PeRM/Industry/VPro [20]-[23] 精准定义了这四大蓝海维度，但对应的**算法突破、数据集、基础设施、评测闭环**均处于起步期。**
